WITH RECURSIVE edges AS (
  SELECT u1.id AS id1, u2.id AS id2
  FROM users u1 JOIN users u2 ON u1.ref1 = u2.ref1 OR u1.ref2 = u2.ref2
), reach (root, id) AS (
  SELECT id, id FROM users
  UNION
  SELECT r.root, e.id2 FROM reach r JOIN edges e ON e.id1 = r.id
), grp AS (
  SELECT id, MIN(root) AS grp_id FROM reach GROUP BY id
), merged AS (
  SELECT g.grp_id,
         ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.id) AS ids,
         ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.username) AS usernames,
         ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.ref1) AS refs1,
         ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.ref2) AS refs2
  FROM grp g JOIN users u ON u.id = g.id
  GROUP BY g.grp_id
), owners AS (
  SELECT m.ids, m.usernames, m.refs1, m.refs2, a.id AS asset_id
  FROM assets a
  JOIN merged m ON a.owner = ANY (m.refs1) OR a.owner = ANY (m.refs2)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, ARRAY[a.owner], a.id
  FROM assets a
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE a.owner IN (u.ref1, u.ref2))
)
SELECT ids, usernames, refs1, refs2,
       ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT asset_id) AS asset_ids,
       COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM owners
GROUP BY ids, usernames, refs1, refs2
ORDER BY MIN(asset_id);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION f_gap_fill_update(tbl text, id text, row_num text) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $func$
DECLARE
  _tbl regclass := tbl::regclass;
  _sql text;
BEGIN
  SELECT concat_ws(' '
         , 'UPDATE ' || _tbl || ' t SET (' || string_agg(quote_ident(a.attname), ', ' ORDER BY a.attnum) || ')'
         , '= ROW(' || string_agg('u.' || quote_ident(a.attname), ', ' ORDER BY a.attnum) || ')'
         , 'FROM (SELECT ctid AS _ctid, '
             || string_agg(format('gap_fill(%1$I) OVER w AS %1$I', a.attname), ', ' ORDER BY a.attnum)
             || ' FROM ' || _tbl
             || format(' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY %I ORDER BY %I ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)', id, row_num)
             || ') u'
         , 'WHERE t.ctid = u._ctid'
         , 'AND (' || string_agg('t.' || quote_ident(a.attname), ', ' ORDER BY a.attnum) || ') IS DISTINCT FROM ('
                  || string_agg('u.' || quote_ident(a.attname), ', ' ORDER BY a.attnum) || ')')
  INTO _sql
  FROM pg_attribute a
  WHERE a.attrelid = _tbl
    AND a.attnum > 0
    AND NOT a.attisdropped
    AND NOT a.attnotnull;

  IF _sql IS NOT NULL THEN
    EXECUTE _sql;
  END IF;
END
$func$;

WITH RECURSIVE walk(a, b, path_a, path_b, ancestor) AS (
  SELECT 1001, 1201, ARRAY[1001], ARRAY[1201], CASE WHEN 1001 = 1201 THEN 1001 END
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n.pa, n.pb,
         CASE WHEN n.pa IS NULL THEN w.path_a ELSE w.path_a || n.pa END,
         CASE WHEN n.pb IS NULL THEN w.path_b ELSE w.path_b || n.pb END,
         CASE WHEN n.pa = ANY (w.path_b || n.pb) THEN n.pa
              WHEN n.pb = ANY (w.path_a || n.pa) THEN n.pb END
  FROM walk w
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (SELECT parent_id FROM lineage WHERE id = w.a) AS pa,
                             (SELECT parent_id FROM lineage WHERE id = w.b) AS pb) n
  WHERE w.ancestor IS NULL AND (w.a IS NOT NULL OR w.b IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT ancestor AS common_ancestor FROM walk WHERE ancestor IS NOT NULL;

),
combined AS (

         qr1.subgroup AS subgroup1,

  FROM qr1 FULL OUTER JOIN qr2 ON qr1.item = qr2.item

),
reach(item, linked) AS (
  SELECT a, b FROM edges
  UNION
  SELECT r.item, e.b FROM reach r JOIN edges e ON e.a = r.linked
),
comp AS (
  SELECT item, MIN(linked) AS root FROM reach GROUP BY item

SELECT t.team_long_name,
       count(*)                                                AS matches,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.gf > x.ga)                     AS victories,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.gf < x.ga)                     AS defeats,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.gf = x.ga)                     AS draws,
       3 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.gf > x.ga)
         + count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.gf = x.ga)                 AS score
FROM team t
JOIN match m ON t.team_api_id IN (m.home_team_api_id, m.away_team_api_id)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE WHEN t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id THEN m.home_team_goal ELSE m.away_team_goal END AS gf,
           CASE WHEN t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id THEN m.away_team_goal ELSE m.home_team_goal END AS ga
) x
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY victories DESC;

  union all
  select transfer.id,
         (case when cte.cum_sum > 20 then transfer.amount else cte.cum_sum + transfer.amount end),
         (case when cte.cum_sum > 20 then cte.bucket + 1 else cte.bucket end)
  from cte
  join transfer on transfer.id = cte.id + 1
)

from cte
order by id;

WITH RECURSIVE s AS (
  SELECT id, trx, event, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS rn
  FROM sales_transactions
), r AS (
  SELECT rn, id,
         trx::numeric            AS sum_trx,
         (event * trx)::numeric  AS result,
         (event * trx)::numeric  AS sum_result
  FROM s
  WHERE rn = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.rn, s.id,
         r.sum_trx + s.trx,
         s.event * (r.sum_trx + s.trx + r.sum_result),
         r.sum_result + s.event * (r.sum_trx + s.trx + r.sum_result)
  FROM r
  JOIN s ON s.rn = r.rn + 1
)
SELECT id, round(result, 6) AS result
FROM r
ORDER BY id;

  SELECT fundingtype, count,
         count*100.0/SUM(count) OVER () AS exact_pct,
         FLOOR(count*100.0/SUM(count) OVER ()) AS floor_pct
  FROM cte_funding_count
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT fundingtype, count, exact_pct, floor_pct,
         100 - SUM(floor_pct) OVER () AS remainder,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY exact_pct - floor_pct DESC, count DESC) AS rn
  FROM pct
)
SELECT fundingtype, count,
       (floor_pct + CASE WHEN rn <= remainder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS percent
FROM ranked;
